Page 9 (Request 5, 2026-11-12): images generated with the Higgsfield API, Marketing Studio Image 2.5 Flare (marketing-studio/image/flare, quality high, 2k, enhance_prompt false), using the canonical character sheets and the layout PNG as ordered references. Shoulder-length black hair tied in a low bun with a few loose strands, slim build, small gold stud earrings, a stethoscope worn around her neck (never in use) in every scene where she wears the white coat (manga supplement, from the accepted reference sheet).

script.style: Full-colour, approachable Indian slice-of-life manga. Clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural daylight, restrained blue and teal accents, simple readable backgrounds. Expressive but natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, numbers, speech bubbles or captions inside the artwork; device screens show only abstract blank blocks and simple icons.
script.continuity: Keep Dr. Ananya, Meera, Ravi, the Nurse, Mr. Raman, Priya, the Pharmacist and the Lab Technician identical to their canonical reference sheets in face traits, hair, build, skin tone and clothing for the whole comic. Device screens never show readable text or real personal data. Page 10 panels 2-3 (10-2, 10-3) are a future vision: soft pale-blue vignette border and lighter, airy palette so they never read as current features.

Three equal tiles side by side across the middle: LEFT a simple tooth chart (two arches of small rounded teeth, two teeth tinted teal); CENTRE a simple eye diagram (an iris circle with three small teal marker dots and short lines); RIGHT a small growth chart (a rising curve on a light grid) beside a small vaccine card with three tick marks. The laptop stands at about a three-quarter angle toward the reader, so its screen is readable while Ananya can still use it. Panel B, middle left: 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' has a short tail to 'ravi'. Below it is a teal label 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients'. Panel C, middle right: 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' has a tail to 'meera'. 'ravi' is only a dot and name at the right edge. Panel D, full-width bottom tier: caption 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' with 'ananya', 'meera' and 'ravi'. Reading order: Meera 'Welbuk Health is designed...', Ravi 'So I can keep...', WELBUK HEALTH label, Meera 'That's the idea...', caption.
pages.observation: The image hash matches the earlier request, and the image looks the same. The scene moves from Ananya's consultation (page 06) to Meera with Ravi with no caption or establishing cue for the new place or time. The exchange itself follows. Meera's 'Let's walk through what is available to you' is never shown paid off, because page 08 jumps to 'Meanwhile, the pharmacy...'. In Panel C the 'ravi' name text runs past the right border, and he has no placeholder box. The WELBUK HEALTH label's left edge sits on the panel border. In Panel D the 'ananya' label is cut to 'anany' by the meera box. Ananya appears in Panel D although she was not in this scene. The text is readable.
